name: Suppressing Sweep
description: Rake fire across the target and up to two others crowding it.

name: Field Patch
description: Once per fight, slap on a trauma seal for 20% max HP - no Ions.

name: Armor-Piercing Rounds
description: Switch to sabot loads and punch through part of the target's plating.

name: Fire Discipline
description: Call the shots; nearby allies hit harder for a while.

name: Breach Stance
description: Set your feet behind the shield - incoming damage drops.

name: Confirmed Kill
description: Heavy bonus damage against anything already below a quarter health.

name: Triage
description: Stabilize one wound - a focused heal (Ion cost).

name: Combat Stim
description: Push a stimulant; your strikes land harder for a while.

name: Purge Echo
description: Flood the room with a resonance burst - devastating to fray-echoes.

name: Broad-Spectrum
description: Field-treat yourself and every ally in the room.

name: Crash Cart
description: Rare: bring a downed ally back on partial vitals. Long cooldown.

name: Iso Field
description: Throw up a sterile bubble - a brief window of total immunity.

name: First Strike
description: Massive bonus damage on the opening hit against an untouched target.

name: Ghost Protocol
description: Drop off sensors for a beat; your next hit is a guaranteed crit.

name: Nerve Agent
description: Coat your blade - the target bleeds toxin for several rounds.

name: Flank
description: Slip around to an ally's target and land two hits this round.

name: Black Market Contacts
description: Permanent: better buy and sell prices at every store.

name: Tag and Track
description: Paint a target - everything that hits it does more, rest of the fight.

name: Ion Lance
description: A focused discharge of tunnel-charge - burst single-target damage.

name: Arc Cascade
description: The discharge jumps to a second nearby target.

name: Overcharge
description: Your next ability costs no Ions and hits harder.

name: Resonance Bloom
description: A field pulse that catches every enemy in the fight.

name: Charge Siphon
description: Passive: pull ambient tunnel-charge faster - Ions regen quicker.

name: Rupture
description: Capstone: tear a local seam open on top of everything. Long cooldown.

name: Dampener
description: Clamp a field brake on the target - its Speed drops for several rounds.

name: Jump Rig
description: A rigged micro-jump - short teleport to escape or reposition.

name: Sabotage
description: Foul the target's gear; its attack power stays down all fight.

name: Holo Decoy
description: Project a decoy that soaks one hit.

name: Loop Splice
description: Splice a half-second back into your line - act twice in a row.

name: Phase Out
description: Capstone: shunt a non-boss enemy out of the timeline entirely.
